About this book

22 first words, one per page, each with a sound, sign or move to copy and a grown-up tip.

Up! Go! More! is a talk-along first-words book for ages 0–3, a paperback printed on demand. It is bright, uncluttered and made for laps and back-and-forth. Each of its 22 word pages shows one everyday word a little one really uses, from hi and peekaboo to eat, help, more, all done and night-night. The word is set in huge rounded letters above one big, friendly picture.

Every page also gives you two small things to do together. A Say it, Sign it or Act it cue offers one sound, simple hand sign or move to copy, like tapping fingertips for more or hiding your eyes for peekaboo. A short grown-up tip turns reading into a back-and-forth chat: pause and wait, add one word, offer a choice, copy each other, or follow your child’s lead. A look, a point, a sign or a tap on a talking device all count as a turn. There is no script and nothing to get right. Pick any tip and skip any tip.

The front pages explain how to read together in four plain steps. The back pages show where the words live in your day, from mealtime to bedtime, and include a keepsake word list, pages to add your family’s own words, and a free printable bonus for grown-ups. The paperback has paper pages: read it together, and keep it away from mouths.

Up! Go! More! is Book 1 of the Talk-Along Firsts series. Next come sounds and animals, then routines and feelings.

What you get

  • 22 real first words, one per page: hi, peekaboo, up, down, go, stop, ball, in, open, wow, uh-oh, help, clap, shoe, eat, cup, more, all done, bye-bye, book, hug, night-night
  • A Say it, Sign it or Act it cue on every page: one sound, simple hand sign or move for you and your little one to copy together
  • A grown-up tip on every page with one easy talk idea: wait, add a word, offer a choice, copy each other, follow their lead. A sign, a point or a device tap counts as a turn
  • Huge rounded letters and one big, bold, uncluttered picture per page, with a varied cast of toddlers, parents and grandparents (a grandparent in glasses, a toddler with a hearing aid)
  • Extras for families: a how-to-read page, a words-through-your-day guide, a keepsake word list, add-your-own-words pages and a free printable bonus

Grown-up corner

A tip on every page, word for word.

  1. hi

    Take turns. Say “hi!” and count to five in your head. A look, wave or sound back counts as a turn.

  2. up

    Wait for it. Hold your arms out, then pause. When they reach up, say “up!” as you lift.

  3. ball

    Add one word. If your child says “ball,” you say “big ball” or “roll ball.” Just one step ahead.

  4. help

    Set up a reason to ask. Put a favorite toy just out of reach and wait. A reach, point or sound is asking.

  5. more

    Pause the fun. Stop the bubbles, ask “more?” and wait. A sign, a look or a sound means go again.

  6. night-night

    Wind down. Say “night-night” to everything: the duck, the moon, even the tablet. A calm goodnight game.

Questions

What ages is it for?

Ages 0–3, read together with a grown-up. Babies look and listen; toddlers start to copy the sounds, signs and moves. The paperback has paper pages, so it is a book to share, not a baby’s own book to chew.

What’s inside?

22 word pages, each with one word, one big picture, one sound, sign or move to copy and a grown-up tip. Plus a how-to-read page, a words-through-your-day page, a keepsake word list, add-your-own-words frames and a QR code for a free printable bonus.

Is it a good gift?

Yes. Order it with the recipient’s address and use the store’s gift options at checkout. The free bonus asks only for a child’s birth month and year.

Are the hand signs from a sign language?

They are simple everyday signs many families use, described in plain words. The book is not a sign-language course.

My child signs, points or uses a talking device. Is this book a good fit?

Yes. The book says it plainly: a look, a point, a sign, a sound or a tap on a talking device is your child’s turn.

We speak another language at home. Can we use it?

Yes. Talk, sing and read in the language you know best; every language counts. Say each word in your home language, and use the ‘Add your own words’ page for your family’s words. There is no Spanish or bilingual edition yet.

How does a printed book reach me?

Each copy is printed when you order it and shipped by the printer, with tracking by email. The time to print and deliver is shown at checkout before you pay.

What can I do with it?

Use it with your own household, as often as you like. Please share a link to this page rather than the files. License terms

What if something is wrong?

Our shipping and returns page sets out exactly what happens if a file is broken, a book arrives damaged, or something isn’t as described.
